Experience in integrations, data conversion and migration. Hands-on experience in Oracle application configuration, testing and implementation. Ability to lead CRP, SIT and UAT activities. Experience preparing functional specifications, configuration workbooks and test scripts. Strong stakeholder management, team leadership and communication skills. Knowledge of OUM, AIM or other implementation methodologies. Valid passport and willingness to travel for client engagements. Technical Expertise: 🔹 Oracle Fusion Financials: GL, AP, AR, Expenses, Fixed Assets and Cash Management. 🔹 Oracle Fusion PPM: Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Foundation, Project Contracts, Project Control, Project Resource Management and Project Performance Reporting. Candidates with strong expertise in either Financials or PPM are encouraged to apply. Knowledge of both domains is an advantage. 🎓 Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, IT or a related discipline. CA, CMA or MBA Finance is an added advantage. 📩 Interested candidates: Share your updated CV at raghul.r@gsshrsolutions.com #Hiring #OracleFusion #OracleFinancials #OraclePPM #OracleEBS #OracleERP #FunctionalManager #SriLankaJobs #ColomboJobs

review_candidates.company: 上海泓明供应链有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 工作职责: 1、设计多平台订单协同方案（对接SAP、ERP、TMS），支持全渠道订单履约 ； 2、开发智能订单路由引擎（基于库存、关税成本、物流时效动态分配仓库）； 3、需求调研，搭建跨境订单清关状态可视化看板； 4、打通关务-WMS-OMS数据流（如保税订单“三单对碰”自动化）； 5、主导系统上线：编写PRD、原型设计、UAT测试、用户培训及运维支持。 任职资格: 1、本科及以上学历，供应链管理/物流工程/计算机相关专业； 2、2年以上供应链系统产品经验，至少主导过1个关务系统或WMS/OMS项目落地； 3、熟练使用Axure/Sketch、SQL、流程图工具； 4、拥有保税仓/海外仓业务落地经验、具备跨境供应链合规认证知识（如GDPR、FDA）； 5、学习能力强，主动积极。
